content.title: Oscars 2026: Full winners list from the 98th Academy Awards
content.text: CultureSee who won best picture, which films took home the most Oscars and more.March 15, 2026, 9:37 PMHollywood's biggest stars gathered Sunday night to celebrate the year's standout achievements in film at the 98th Academy Awards."One Battle After Another" claimed the night's top honor, winning the Oscar for best picture, while the film's director, Paul Thomas Anderson, earned the award for best director.Other top prizes went to Michael B. Jordan, who won best actor for "Sinners," and Jessie Buckley, who received the best actress Oscar for "Hamnet."Amy Madigan secured the Oscar for best supporting actress for her role in "Weapons," while Sean Penn won best supporting actor for "One Battle After Another."The ceremony also marked the debut of a new category called best achievement in casting, with "One Battle After Another" taking home the inaugural award. It is the first competitive category added by the Academy since best animated feature was introduced in 2001.The 2026 Oscars were hosted by Conan O'Brien, who returned to emcee the ceremony for the second year in a row. The awards were held at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles and broadcast live on ABC, with streaming also available on Hulu.
